\# StreamDek Mobile v2.1.7



\*Version code 63\*



> \*\*Needs the current StreamDek backend.\*\* Sync, watchlist and Continue Watching artwork depend on server-side changes shipping first. Everything else works as soon as you update.



\## New



\*\*SyncDek\*\* — StreamDek's own sync, and a new choice for where your Continue Watching and watchlist live. No account to connect; it's on whenever you're signed in. Pick it in \*\*Settings → Sync Services\*\*, alongside Trakt, SIMKL, PunchPlay and MDBList. Whichever you choose, every service you've connected still receives your watchlist changes, so nothing goes quiet.



\*\*Sync Services, rebuilt.\*\* The page now opens by telling you what's doing your syncing and whether it's up to date, with \*\*Sync now\*\* at the top instead of buried at the bottom under a heading that never mentioned it. Each option says in plain words what it actually does for you.



\*\*New Episodes\*\* — a home row of followed series whose latest episode has just landed. Wide cards using a still from the episode itself, labelled `NEW · S1 E4 · Today`. Prefer series posters? \*\*Settings → Home Screen → Wide New Episode Cards\*\*.



\*\*New-episode reminders\*\* for watchlisted and in-progress series.



\*\*Live TV, rebuilt.\*\* "View All" is a proper channel list now — last-watched card, search, All / Favourites / Category filters and a category sheet — instead of a grid of category tiles standing between you and the channels. Favourites uses the same screen.



\*\*PunchPlay\*\* as a tracking service.



\*\*Dolby Vision profile 7.\*\* Profile 7 remuxes decoded to a black picture without ever reporting an error. They're now recognised as playback starts and handed to mpv, which plays them, resuming where you were. \*\*Settings → Streams → Playback → DV7-HEVC Fallback\*\*. \*\*Tunneled Playback\*\* is there too.



\*\*Remove from Continue Watching\*\* on the long-press sheet.



Separate ambient background tint for the home screen and title pages.



\## Improved



\*\*Light mode.\*\* One accent palette served both themes, and those accents are pale by design — so filled buttons, focused fields, checked switches and text buttons were near-white on white. Light mode has its own colours, outlines and container tints now.



\*\*Posters load properly.\*\* All artwork comes from one host and was capped at five requests at a time, which is why rows only filled in as you scrolled to them.



\*\*Stream results\*\* grouped by source, then quality band, then size, following your Preferred Quality, with a download icon on the rows that can actually be saved. Results that named nothing now carry the title you're watching instead of a bare resolution.



\*\*Trailers pick properly.\*\* Running time decides, not whatever came back first — a two-minute trailer beats a fifteen-second ticket advert whatever either is called. A Short only plays when a title has nothing else. KinoCheck is now the last resort rather than the first choice.



\*\*Continue Watching names the episode.\*\* Tapping resumes it directly; if the source it used has gone, you land on \*\*that episode's\*\* source list rather than the top of the series page.



\*\*Your place syncs with your TV\*\* — position, finishes and removals, in both directions, and kept per profile so two people sharing an account no longer share one set of resume points.



\*\*Marking something watched\*\* reaches your other devices, and clears the title from every connected service's watchlist rather than only Trakt's.



\## Fixed



\- \*\*Text fields hidden behind the keyboard\*\* throughout Settings — the MDBList access key among them.

\- \*\*Blank Continue Watching cards\*\*, and cards that \*lost\* their artwork after syncing.

\- \*\*Seasons with no artwork of their own\*\* showed an empty tile instead of the series poster.

\- \*\*Live Favourites and Live TV headers\*\* sat underneath the status bar.

\- \*\*Clearing Continue Watching\*\* only cleared this device — your TV kept the whole list.

\- Episode pages take their colour from their own still.

\- Clipped settings descriptions can be expanded.
